test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word.

They want to __bifurcate__ the states.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2 (Combine)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"bifurcate"** means to divide something into two branches or parts. (विभाजित करना) • **Example: **The river bifurcates into two smaller streams as it flows through the valley. • The word **"combine"** refers to the act of uniting or merging two or more things into one. (मिलाना) • **Example: **We need to combine our efforts to achieve success in this project. • As the antonym of **"bifurcate"** is to merge or unite rather than divide, the correct answer is **"combine"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 (Combine)**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Divide **(विभाजित करना): To separate something into parts or pieces. • **Example:** The teacher asked the students to divide the cake equally among themselves. • **Examine **(जांचना): To inspect or analyze something carefully. • **Example: **The doctor examined the patient for any signs of illness. • **Support **(समर्थन करना): To give assistance or approval to something or someone. • **Example:** The community came together to support the local fundraiser. 1ac:T92c,
